# 黃帝內經靈樞略

**ID:** KR5d0041
**Custom ID:** ZB5d0036

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Abridged Huángdì Nèijīng Língshū*

Anonymous; Táng-Sòng

An **abridged** (*lüè* 略) recension of the *Líng shū* 靈樞 — the second half of the *Huáng dì nèi jīng*. Preserved as **DZ 1019** / CT 1019 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部). See [KR5d0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0042) for the Southern-Sòng Shǐ Sōng recension.

**Dating.** Táng-Sòng. Dynasty: 唐-宋.
